page_summary: This section discusses financial barriers to cybersecurity investment in ports, highlighting that many ports struggle to justify spending despite recognizing risks. It emphasizes the importance of leadership buy-in for securing ongoing investment and the need to quantify cyber risks in financial terms. The text also mentions tools like the Return on Security Investment (ROSI) and the Gordon-Loeb Model to help translate cyber risk into monetary terms, aiding decision-making for investment in cybersecurity.
